notes: Copr chroots the release build targets. epel-9/epel-10 cover AlmaLinux/Rocky/RHEL 9/10.
Two package families come out of one SRPM: the base 'php-pinba' built against each target's distro-native PHP (no Remi), plus the Remi SCL 'php<XY>-php-pinba' subpackages.

base_php_version is the distro-native PHP for that target (Fedora base repos / EL AppStream). Informational: the base build always runs and picks up whatever php-devel the chroot ships. Probed from Fedora metadata; EL values are documented constants.

On EL the base PHP comes from the AppStream php module stream (php:8.1 on EL9); enable the php module for the epel chroots in the Copr project's Buildroot customization if the default stream does not resolve php-devel in mock.
php_versions per target is the intersection of supported branches (php-versions.json) and Remi availability for that target; update-rpm-matrix.php keeps it accurate from Remi metadata.
Remi must be configured per chroot in the Copr project (fedora baseurl on Fedora chroots, enterprise baseurl on EL chroots) — a project-wide baseurl 404s on the other family and fails the build.
A new PHP branch is not built for a target until Remi actually ships its php<XY>-php-devel there.
